log_level.description: Logging verbosity level: debug, info, warning, error, or critical

log_environment.description: Environment tag added to log entries (e.g., production, staging, dev)

log_file.description: Enable file logging (if true, logs written to /var/log/registry/registry.log)

storage_driver.description: Storage backend driver. Supported: filesystem, s3, gcs, azure, swift, inmemory (dev only)

storage_filesystem_rootdirectory.description: Path on local filesystem where image data is stored (for 'filesystem' driver)

s3_region.description: AWS region of S3 bucket (e.g., us-east-1, eu-west-1)

s3_bucket.description: S3 bucket name for registry storage

s3_keyid.description: KMS key ID for encryption (optional, used only if s3_encrypt=true and SSE-KMS)

s3_v4auth.description: Use AWS Signature Version 4 for authentication

gcs_bucket.description: GCS bucket name for registry storage

gcs_keyid.description: KMS key ID for GCS encryption (optional)

gcs_private_key.description: Base64-encoded private key JSON (for service account auth)

gcs_user_project.description: GCP project ID to bill for access (if bucket is requester-pays)

storage_delete_enabled.description: Enable deletion of layers and manifests (required for garbage collection)

storage_cache_blobdescriptor.description: Cache manifest/blob descriptor metadata in memory (improves performance)

storage_redirect.description: Redirect client requests directly to backend storage (e.g., S3 presigned URLs)

http_addr.description: HTTP listener address (host:port) for registry API

tls_enabled.description: Enable TLS/HTTPS on the registry API

tls_keystore.description: Path to TLS certificate chain (PEM format)

tls_key.description: Path to TLS private key (PEM format)

tls_client_ca.description: Path to CA certificate bundle for mutual TLS (mTLS) client auth

debug_addr.description: Address for debug endpoints (health, metrics, pprof)

debug_pprof_enabled.description: Enable pprof debugging endpoints (dangerous in production)

debug_trace_sampler.description: If true: always sample traces; if false: use probabilistic sampling

debug_trace_sampler_param.description: Sampling rate (0.0–1.0) when probabilistic sampling is used

auth_token_service.description: Token service name (must match issuer expectation)

auth_token_rootcertbundle.description: Path to CA bundle for validating token signatures

auth_htpasswd_realm.description: Basic auth realm (shown in browser login dialog)

proxy_remoteurl.description: Upstream registry URL (for pull-through caching, e.g., https://registry-1.docker.io)

notifications_enabled.description: Enable webhook notifications on image pushes/pulls

url.description: Webhook URL (POST will be sent with JSON payload)

headers.description: HTTP headers to include with each request

threshold.description: Number of failed requests before marking endpoint unhealthy

disabled.description: Disable this endpoint without deleting it

notifications_endpoints.description: List of webhook endpoints to notify on registry events

health_storagedriver_enabled.description: Enable health endpoint that checks storage driver connectivity

health_storagedriver_threshold.description: Number of failed checks before marking unhealthy
